video_title: EXCLUSIVE: Newest Lakers guard Quentin Grimes SPEAKS 🗣️- Mason & Ireland

quotes.speaker: Quentin Grimes
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes on his decision to join the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Nobody expected Luka to be with the Lakers and we had a good little run with Dallas.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Mason
text_blocks.text: I know why the Lakers wanted you. We needed to get younger, more athletic. Luka likes you as a teammate. Why were you interested in the Lakers? Why was this a good fit from your end?

text_blocks.speaker: Quentin Grimes
text_blocks.text: I think everybody wants to be wanted as a player and I feel like there was a lot of mutual interest. We have seen me and the Lakers for a while now and nobody expected Luka to be with the Lakers and we had a good little run with Dallas. I knew Jalen Brunson, I knew Jarred Vanderbilt, I knew Kurt Rambis and stuff like that already. So it was kind of a no-brainer and a great fit honestly.

quotes.speaker: Quentin Grimes
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes on his expected role with the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I want to have a pretty big offensive role within the team, but also have a big elite leadership role.

text_blocks.speaker: Chris 'Geeter' McGee
text_blocks.text: How much did opportunity play a role for you in terms of what kind of role you would have for the Lakers?

text_blocks.speaker: Quentin Grimes
text_blocks.text: That was really one of the biggest selling points. Talking with Jalen and them and having them be able to pitch me what my role would look like. Coming in and having a pretty big offensive role within the team, but also have a big elite leadership role on defense as well, taking on that challenge every night. I am guarding the best players and wanting that responsibility. I want to have that challenge every night, so that was one of the two main things when I was choosing in free agency.

quotes.speaker: Quentin Grimes
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes on the difficulty of guarding Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: Nobody in the NBA is really 6'8" with that pace. He plays with his own rhythm, his own cadence.
quotes.quote: I think it is really just his pace. Nobody in the NBA is really 6'8" with that pace. He plays with his own rhythm, his own cadence and then he is digging up, it just puts you on a hip and just bumps and you shoot a fade over you, or he can just get all the way downhill and make plays. He has one-of-one vision out there on the court, so his size and pace is just one-of-one in the NBA really. He put 60 on my head when I was in New York, so I am glad I am good, I get to be on the offensive end and back with him again for sure.

quotes.speaker: Quentin Grimes
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes on his defensive goals for the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Being a point of attack defender that I am, have been for four or five years in the NBA.
quotes.quote: Taking on that challenge, you know, being a point of attack defender that I am, have been for four or five years in the NBA. New York did a great job with me, teaching me the ropes of how to be a pro and giving me that challenge early on in my career. Being back here with Jalen, we already talked about it, and just being in elite shape, elite condition and take on that challenge every night. I feel like I will be super prepared and super ready to take on that challenge every night.

quotes.speaker: Quentin Grimes
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes on the defensive impact of Austin Reaves and Jarred Vanderbilt
quotes.excerpt: Everybody knows what he does, nobody wants to go in that paint. 7'2" guy, he is going to block shots.
quotes.quote: AR had a fantastic season last year, well deserving of the contract that he got and everything. He is one of the best scorers for sure in the NBA probably. Walker, one of the best rim protectors, even though he only played was like four or five games last year, but everybody knows what he does, nobody wants to go in that paint. 7'2" guy, he is going to block shots. So this is going to give us a definite advantage. People are not going to go in that paint, so we can guard and put pressure on the ball even more knowing we got big Walker down in the paint holding it down. And even we got guys like Rui, like Dog, my dog already been out here getting working. So it is going to be a lot of fun.

quotes.speaker: Quentin Grimes
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes on his offensive development and role
quotes.excerpt: I know I have the ball in my hands a lot coming off pick and roll, making plays.
quotes.quote: This year, I knew I was going to have a little more bigger offensive role. You got to know who you are playing with, Luka. He sets you up for any run on the court, so just make sure I am in those corners, getting those corner threes up. But also, I know I have the ball in my hands a lot coming off pick and roll, making plays. I feel like my last few seasons in Dallas and Philly, I was really able to kind of show my whole package as offensively, making reads, whether that is creating a shot for me or creating a shot for my teammates.

quotes.speaker: Quentin Grimes
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes on the potential of rookie Arthur Kaluma
quotes.excerpt: He plays with a different confidence and different kind of swagger. He definitely is an NBA player.
quotes.quote: You can tell guys who got a little bit different swagger, different attention to detail during the game, a little bit more of a pop and aggressiveness. You can tell that from the jump at the game last game. We were watching it, he is shooting the ball every time he shot it, we thought we were going in on the side, me, Kyle, and Bronny, we were like, oh it is good. Every time he shot it, he plays with a different confidence and different kind of swagger. So he definitely is an NBA player for sure, 100%.

quotes.speaker: Quentin Grimes
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes on the lessons learned from playoff basketball
quotes.excerpt: You got to take one game at a time. You cannot worry about a game seven.
quotes.quote: You got to take one game at a time. You cannot worry about a game seven. You got to come in with the right mindset every game and if you lose one game, it is only one game in the best of seven. And that was our mindset in Philly. We kind of shocked, did a special thing coming out from 3-1 and then ran into New York who is on the heater and we caught them at the wrong time and it just be like that sometimes.

quotes.speaker: Quentin Grimes
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes on his brother Tyler Myers and his athletic background
quotes.excerpt: My brother got me beat on that with my dad. He raised him a little bit when he was younger.
quotes.quote: I think my brother got me beat on that with my dad. He raised him a little bit when he was younger. He said he had a nice little crossover, but I do not skate. I am from the south from Texas. I do not even think we have an ice rink down there, but I just stick to the basketball. And I wish I had a little bit of his height because he is 6'8", so if I had a couple of inches of height on that side, I think it would be a whole different conversation.
